assessments.reason: Reviewed official RustSec RUSTSEC-2026-0370 (informational/unmaintained, dated 2026-10-16): standalone zvariant was merged into zbus 6's wire module; no vulnerability or patched standalone release is asserted. This exact SHA-256-bound application lock uses zvariant 5.12.0 through the same zbus 5.16.0 notification, portal and OS-vault integrations documented in docs/ZBUS-MAINTENANCE-REVIEW.md. A coordinated parent migration is required; a forced direct dependency change does not remove the constrained transitive stack. Keep the finding visible and reassess by 2026-11-15. Different lock bytes, versions, vulnerability/unsound findings or expiry fail closed. This is not an upstream fix. Source: https://github.com/RustSec/advisory-db/blob/999ec89d5d3f10f20be14750ec8c2d8b44e0ac9b/crates/zvariant/RUSTSEC-2026-0370.md

Reviewed official RustSec RUSTSEC-2026-0372 (informational/unmaintained, dated 2026-10-16): standalone zvariant_derive macros moved into zbus 6; no vulnerability or patched standalone release is asserted. This exact SHA-256-bound application lock requires zvariant_derive 5.12.0 with zvariant 5.12.0 and the zbus 5.16.0 notification, portal and OS-vault parent chain. Review the coordinated migration in docs/ZBUS-MAINTENANCE-REVIEW.md by 2026-11-15 rather than forcing incompatible transitive APIs. The warning remains visible; changed lock bytes, versions, finding kinds and expiry fail closed. This is not an upstream fix. Source: https://github.com/RustSec/advisory-db/blob/999ec89d5d3f10f20be14750ec8c2d8b44e0ac9b/crates/zvariant_derive/RUSTSEC-2026-0372.md

Reviewed RustSec RUSTSEC-2026-0371 (informational/unmaintained, dated 2026-10-16): standalone zbus_names was merged into zbus 6; no vulnerability or patched standalone release is asserted. This exact SHA-256-bound application lock requires zbus_names 4.3.2 through zbus/zbus_macros 5.16.0, notify-rust 4.18.2, secret-service 5.2.0, zbus-secret-service-keyring-store 1.0.1 and ashpd 0.11.1/rfd 0.16.0. A complete migration must coordinate notification, portal and OS-vault integrations; forcing only a direct zbus 6 update would retain the transitive zbus 5 dependency and does not resolve this finding. Keep the warning visible and reassess the coordinated upstream migration by 2026-11-15. New versions, warning kinds, lock bytes, vulnerabilities or expiry fail closed. This is a time-limited maintenance assessment, not an upstream fix or a vulnerability exclusion. Source: https://github.com/RustSec/advisory-db/blob/999ec89d5d3f10f20be14750ec8c2d8b44e0ac9b/crates/zbus_names/RUSTSEC-2026-0371.md

The patched builder removes RPM OpenPGP entirely. Remaining RSA is selected only by tauri-macos-sign 2.4.2 (crate SHA256 b2ad3a8236db04071cb4ec8ebebb05dfac392f83d2dbc1cde18afcb8f5af65a2) on macOS. Its sole direct RSA use is ephemeral self-signed certificate key generation, not the RSA decryption affected by the Marvin advisory. Linux/Windows builders do not compile that target dependency. Canonical builds additionally reject signing credentials; isolated updater signing uses Minisign Ed25519. Whole-lock scanning still reports and expires this exact advisory assessment; no upstream RSA patch is claimed.

GTK3/GLib 0.18 derive-tooling dependency; no vulnerability is asserted by this maintenance advisory. Retain ABI compatibility while tracking the complete upstream GTK/WebKit migration. The separate GLib unsoundness is actually backported, not ignored.
Build-only dependency in the exact published supported Tauri CLI lock; no vulnerability is asserted. Reassess together with the next supported CLI update.

Build-only icon/text renderer in the exact supported CLI lock. Only reviewed repository-owned build assets are renderer inputs; builder executable is not published in application packages. Track the supported upstream CLI update.

Build-only font parser in the pinned CLI renderer; no vulnerability is asserted by this maintenance advisory. Reassess with the next supported CLI instead of altering its reviewed published lock silently.
